evaluation: Independent source-semantic review of every raw proposal, including mechanically rejected proposals. Exact quote variations are allowed; role, actor, direction, adoption, time and scope are judged against complete originals. A rejected arm is not a correct abstention. No automatic score or promotion threshold.
